objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Included in the document name after abbreviation and number.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current or released version of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status used in versioning and workflows.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the validity period count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects distribution of workflow tasks when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a new document; can have templates and validity/archive settings.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document names.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period definable for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration definable for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Level 1 document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Level 2 document type documenting regulations and instructions.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Level 3 document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Level 4 document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for amending a document, created and managed without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved in authorizations, workflows, distribution, acknowledgements, translation, or document actions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorization assignment, reader assignment, distribution, archive access, or role assignment.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role available for users in the document management solution.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to documents at user group and person level.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during workflow-supported processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested and documented for distributed document versions.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: E-mail used to inform users about workflow tasks, releases, proposals, validity extension, override, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Object with which documents can be linked, including IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent released version of a document.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard listing documents relevant to a user.

o2o.description: A new document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A template can be selected when creating a new document object.
Policy is described as a document type.
Guideline is described as a document type.
Procedural Instruction is described as a document type.
Work Instruction is described as a document type.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and are associated with the main document version.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document.
The request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as an example of master data.
Documents can be linked with other documents or referenced documents.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users/persons.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser.
Users can be assigned to user groups.
System roles provide users with functions according to their area of application.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning user groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Acknowledgements are documented for documents and current versions.
Workflow tasks are assigned to users involved in the workflow.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented for each released version of a document.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
The translation function allows language-dependent display of released documents.
Role-specific evaluation reports are available.
Role-specific dashboards are available.
Documents relevant to the user are listed in the dashboard.

o2e.description: New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
The corresponding document type is selected.
